clips.title: The story
paras: Executor Zygand sends Forsaken fighters against the Scarlet Crusade near Balnir Farmstead. Their strike targets Captain Vachon and his friars in southeastern Tirisfal Glades, where Crusader raids threaten the Dark Lady's lands.

The Forsaken guard Brill and the Undercity while the Scarlet Crusade holds fortified sites across the countryside. Executor Arren reports active Crusader incursions from a crumbling guard tower in southeastern Tirisfal Glades. The tower stands close to the abandoned Balnir Farmstead.

Executor Zygand targets the Crusade's field leaders, knowing coordinated squads pose a greater danger than scattered zealots. You strike at Captain Vachon and the Scarlet Friars who strengthen his men with holy magic. Without their leadership and support, the cell may lose its cohesion and its raids into Forsaken lands may falter.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We are still at war and the Scarlet Crusade grows in strength. The report Executor Arren sent me indicates Scarlet Crusaders have been raiding from the ruined tower in southeastern Tirisfal near the Balnir Farmstead under the command of Captain Vachon.
Kill Vachon along with 5 Scarlet Friars. It should prove to be a devastating blow to the Crusade!

clips.title: Progress
paras: I see you have returned but your task is not complete. Perhaps you are at ease with the mere humans interfering with The Dark Lady's plan? Or perhaps you can heed the call of duty and slay Captain Vachon and his band of Scarlet Friars!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Captain Vachon's death will slow down the Scarlet Crusade's advancement in Tirisfal quite a bit. But other threats loom.
